Buffet <120-minute limit> Seafood, Yakiniku & Japanese/Western/Chinese Buffet with 150+ Dishes Including King Crab + All-You-Can-Drink Alcohol150 items

<Buffet & 120-minute all-you-can-drink (alcohol included)> In a hotel-style, all-buffet format, indulge in over 150 dishes spanning genres—Yakiniku, snow crab, made-to-order sushi, Chinese, Japanese and Western cuisine, plus desserts. Seafood Buffet Dining Ginza Happo’s highlights include sushi prepared by chefs right before you and a variety of freshly cooked, piping-hot dishes. In the vibrant live kitchen, chefs present a meticulously prepared buffet that is sure to delight all five senses. The refined space, harmonizing Japanese and Western elements, provides the perfect setting for your important moments.

Premium with Jumbo Lobster & Finest Uni — Over 150 Seafood, Yakiniku & Japanese/Western/Chinese Buffet + All You Can Drink Alcohol150 items

<Premium Luxury Buffet & 120-minute All-You-Can-Drink Included> Indulge in our ultimate premium course featuring an extra-large lobster and the finest uni. Savor over 150 gourmet selections, including Edomae sushi hand-pressed by master chefs, Hokkaido-sourced king crab, freshly fried tempura, aromatic Hamayaki (seashore-style grilled seafood), premium Yakiniku, authentic Chinese dishes, and an array of elegant desserts. Relax in a refined setting and enjoy this blissful experience accompanied by fine drinks.
